summary.text: Mark Lawson is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 30 since November 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was selected as House majority leader effective February 3, 2025, and the Republican primary was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Mark Lawson assumed office on November 23, 2016.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Appropriations and Budget Committee and the House Rules Committee, and he chairs the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances.
